faq.q: Is the panel made up of real people?
faq.a: No. AI simulates the panel based on your audience. It suggests which message may persuade and which objections may arise; it does not predict exact sales.

faq.q: Which marketplaces does it work with?
faq.a: eMAG Marketplace, Trendyol, Etsy, Amazon, OLX, Facebook Marketplace, Shopify or your own website, and Instagram Shop.

faq.q: Do I need to know marketing?
faq.a: Not at all. Describe your product as you would to a friend, and Campio gives you practical steps for this week.
You get copy and visuals ready to download and publish yourself. Advertising account integrations are available only when configured.
Accounts use hashed passwords, two-step verification and private sessions. Campaigns and settings belong to your account. Review the operator's privacy policy before using the service.
